_doc: PLAN.md 4.5. A hit drains the ship's shield pool first (raw x vs_shield). What gets through lands on the tile it struck: max(raw x vs_hull - armor x armor_factor x (1 - pierce), raw x min_share). Splash hits every tile within its radius, scaled from 1 at the centre to splash_edge_share at the rim. The pool regenerates after regen_delay_s without a hit; EMP knocks out shields and thrusters for disable_s.

wreck._doc: Phase 4.2. A piece that breaks off drifts away at drift_u U/s plus the ship's motion, spins up to spin rad/s, and fades out over fade_s. When the core goes, the rest splits into chunks of at most explode_chunk_tiles tiles flung out at explode_speed_u U/s.
